mapper.select: SELECT event_id, event_name, description, start_time, end_time, status, created_at FROM event_info ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM ads_event_heat_trend WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY time_bucket ASC
SELECT * FROM ads_platform_spread_timeline WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY first_publish_time ASC
SELECT * FROM ads_event_heat_trend WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND platform <> 'WEIBO' ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, platform ASC
SELECT * FROM ads_platform_spread_timeline WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND platform <> 'WEIBO' ORDER BY avg_heat_index DESC, content_count DESC
SELECT * FROM ads_platform_daily_heat WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, platform ASC
SELECT * FROM ads_platform_category_heat WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND platform <> 'WEIBO' ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, platform ASC, category ASC

WITH hourly_category AS ( SELECT event_id, platform, DATE_FORMAT(publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS time_bucket, category, COUNT(*) AS content_count, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(platform_heat_index, 0)), 2) AS average_relative_heat_index FROM ads_content_hot_rank WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND platform IN ('TENCENT_NEWS', 'NETEASE_NEWS', 'SOHU_NEWS', 'SINA_NEWS', 'THE_PAPER') AND publish_time IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(category), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_id, platform, DATE_FORMAT(publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), category ), hourly_total AS ( SELECT event_id, platform, time_bucket, SUM(content_count) AS platform_content_count FROM hourly_category GROUP BY event_id, platform, time_bucket ) SELECT category.event_id, category.platform, category.time_bucket, category.category, category.content_count, total.platform_content_count, category.average_relative_heat_index FROM hourly_category category JOIN hourly_total total ON total.event_id = category.event_id AND total.platform = category.platform AND total.time_bucket = category.time_bucket ORDER BY category.time_bucket ASC, category.platform ASC, category.category ASC
SELECT * FROM ads_topic_trend WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, burst_index DESC
SELECT * FROM ads_interaction_summary WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY hot_score DESC
SELECT * FROM ads_sentiment_trend WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, sentiment_label ASC

SELECT content_id, title, UPPER(TRIM(platform)) AS platform, publish_time, keywords, clean_text AS content_text, sentiment_label, category, content_type FROM ads_content_hot_rank WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND UPPER(TRIM(platform)) LIKE '%WEIBO%' AND UPPER(TRIM(platform)) NOT IN ('SOHU_NEWS', 'TENCENT_NEWS', 'NETEASE_NEWS', 'SINA_NEWS', 'THE_PAPER') ORDER BY publish_time ASC, id ASC

SELECT content_id, platform, publish_time, keywords, category, author_name, like_count, comment_count, repost_count, favorite_count FROM ads_content_hot_rank WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND platform IN ('SOHU_NEWS', 'TENCENT_NEWS', 'NETEASE_NEWS', 'SINA_NEWS', 'THE_PAPER') AND NULLIF(TRIM(keywords), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY publish_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) topic_count FROM ( SELECT TRIM(title) topic FROM ads_content_hot_rank WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND TRIM(COALESCE(title, '')) <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(title) ) topics

SELECT TRIM(title) topic, COUNT(*) content_count, COUNT(DISTINCT platform) platform_count, MIN(publish_time) first_publish_time, MAX(publish_time) latest_publish_time, SUM(COALESCE(hot_score, 0)) hot_score FROM ads_content_hot_rank WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND TRIM(COALESCE(title, '')) <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(title) ORDER BY hot_score DESC, content_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT parent.platform source_platform, child.platform target_platform, COUNT(*) link_count FROM ads_content_hot_rank child JOIN ads_content_hot_rank parent ON parent.event_id = child.event_id AND parent.content_id = child.parent_content_id WHERE child.event_id = #{eventId} AND NULLIF(TRIM(child.parent_content_id), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY parent.platform, child.platform ORDER BY link_count DESC

WITH topic_platform AS ( SELECT event_id, platform, TRIM(title) title FROM ads_content_hot_rank WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND NULLIF(TRIM(title), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_id, platform, TRIM(title) ) SELECT left_topic.platform source_platform, right_topic.platform target_platform, COUNT(*) link_count FROM topic_platform left_topic JOIN topic_platform right_topic ON left_topic.event_id = right_topic.event_id AND left_topic.platform < right_topic.platform AND left_topic.title = right_topic.title GROUP BY left_topic.platform, right_topic.platform ORDER BY link_count DESC
SELECT * FROM etl_batch WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ads_noise_summary WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY time_bucket ASC
SELECT * FROM etl_batch ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM etl_task_log WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY started_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) event_count FROM event_info
